Variants.Content: Entry Qohor is a river city located on the edge of the forest, far away from the Narrow Sea but connected to the world through trade routes. Temples of the Black Goat, ancient rituals, and mysterious priests make it appear bleak in the eyes of other Free Cities; to the people of Qhor, these beliefs are part of the city's identity and shared identity Qohor is famous for its wood, furs, ironwork, and skilled blacksmithing, and legend has it that a few craftsmen know the art of reforging Valyrian steel. The forest provides resources and barriers to the city, and also keeps wild beasts, bandits, and northern tribes never far away.

Entry Qohor Qohor is a river city located on the edge of the forest, far away from the Narrow Sea but connected to the world through trade routes. Temples of the Black Goat, ancient rituals, and mysterious priests make it appear bleak in the eyes of other Free Cities; to the people of Qhor, these beliefs are part of the city's identity and shared identity. They care about water sources, roads, customs and garrison, and know that behind the place names there is often a food road that can keep the castle alive.
